audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].side read 'Skill' while content win[6] and the packet both read 'Aurelion Sol'.
audit.why: Fully stacked with Stardust, health items and Zhonya's he outlives Death Mark's 3s payout; the first six rows are correctly Zed and already agreed.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side=Aurelion Sol with phases[6].why rewritten to match, rating dropped to 4/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose gave no cooldown for the escape that gates every all-in.
audit.why: Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1 falling to 16s at rank 5 — that gap is the whole kill window.
audit.corrected: Numbers now in breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.mid, breakdown.spikes and spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two wrong ability slots shipped in the content layer: spikes[1].text called Astral Flight his E (it is W) and spikes[3].text called the stun 'Singularity (R)' — Singularity is E and does not stun; the stun is Falling Star (R). Separately, Singularity's centre executes on a percentage of health, which was never stated.
audit.why: Kit slots: Q Breath of Light, W Astral Flight, E Singularity, R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. Riot's E text: 'The center of the black hole executes enemies who are below a certain p[ercent]'; flags percentHealth and execute.
audit.corrected: Both slot labels fixed in the content layer; the percent-health execute stated in tradeBad and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim and dontsFull[2].d the tradeBad string verbatim, both under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to answer their own titles.

edits.before: Death Mark plus a shadow kills him outright before he has the health or Zhonya's to survive. His Astral Flight (E) is a long-range travel tool but on a long cooldown, so all-in when it's down.

edits.before: Aurelion Sol scales into a giant health-and-DPS zone threat with Zhonya's and his Singularity (R) stun; if he stacks freely he out-survives your combo. Your whole game is snowballing before he comes online and picking him before fights.
edits.after: Aurelion Sol scales into a giant health-and-DPS zone threat with Zhonya's, a Falling Star (R) stun and a Singularity (E) that executes at its centre; if he stacks freely he out-survives your combo, so snowball before he arrives.

notes: Chart: only row 6 disagreed; content win[6] already read Aurelion Sol and matched the packet, so side moved alone and phases[6].why was rewritten to match. Two genuine slot errors were shipped in the content layer and are fixed here: Astral Flight labelled (E) when it is W, and 'Singularity (R) stun' when Singularity is E and the stun is Falling Star (R). Only one report entry was rewritten (report[3].t) because it duplicates the trading text this proposal changes. Aurelion Sol is male, so no pronoun findings applied.
